compose_claim_shredder.problem: Viral posts about referral and affiliate commissions stretch time-limited rates into “lifetime”, turn “up to” into a per-sale figure, pass off a friend's reward or platform credit as the referrer's cash, splice separate programs or regions together, reuse superseded terms, and keep promoting programs that are closed, capped or geo-excluded. Readers can't check this quickly. Claim Shredder takes one pasted claim and returns one of four labels, tied to a dated official source, with no earnings math and no codes.
do: Ship one screen: paste box → verdict panel → program board, in that order; no hero, no marketing sections.
Answer with the enumerated output_contract only: label chip + fixed reason line(s) + official source + checked date.
Seed the board with all 15 rows in classifier.seed; show track, status, source and checked date on every row.
Apply the freshness gate: a row can emit 公开规则 / 易误解 / 关门反例 only after a person has read its official page (page_read = true) within 90 days.
Before launch, open every row's official source, confirm or correct its track facts and unresolved items, then set page_read = true and verified_on.
Offer a share line only under share_line.offer_when, from the fixed template that ends with “推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate”; leave {own_link} empty for the user.
Put the standing disclosure in the footer of every view and directly above any share line.
Keep everything bilingual: zh primary line, en secondary line in the muted tone; the four labels always appear as label_set with their en gloss.

Look: calm institutional dark board. Tokens: bg #0B0E12, surface #10151B, hairline #1F2630, text #DCE1E8, muted #8C96A4. Outline label chips: 公开规则 #7FAF95, 易误解 #C8A45E, 未核实 #8C96A4, 关门反例 #B97474. Type: IBM Plex Sans + Noto Sans SC, 15/24, tabular numerals for dates.
Board becomes stacked cards below 640px; 16px side gutter; motion limited to a 150ms opacity fade and off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Process pastes in the browser only; analytics, if any, count labels and reason codes, never paste text.
dont: No personal take-rate, earnings estimate, calculator or 「你能拿 xx%」 / “you'll earn X” phrasing anywhere.
Never generate, complete, echo or store a referral, invite or founder code; never add ref / via / code parameters to any link.
No join CTA, apply button or referral link on a row whose status is not open (closed, capped, geo-limited).
Don't quote or restate numbers from the paste in the verdict.
No hype vocabulary (see acceptance A1) and no urgency or scarcity UI: countdowns, “spots left”, confetti, glow, gradients, emoji.
Don't present a row as verified while page_read = false, and never hide its checked date.
Don't use the gravity.li domain, GRAVITY branding or any vendor's logo or trademark styling; don't imply endorsement.
Don't let a single keyword decide a label across programs; always compare against the matched row and track.
Don't go beyond 未核实 · unknown_program for programs outside the seed.

classifier.mode: Deterministic rules run in the browser. No LLM free text, no server call on paste; the same paste always yields the same output.
classifier.input: One pasted claim, zh or en, up to 2,000 characters. Pasted URLs are stripped before matching and never rendered.
steps: S0 normalize: NFKC (full-width to half-width), Traditional to Simplified (OpenCC t2s), lowercase Latin, collapse whitespace.
S1 match program: aliases in seed[].aliases. None → 未核实 · unknown_program. Several → one verdict per program (max 3).
S2 freshness gate: the row needs page_read = true AND verified_on within 90 days; otherwise 未核实 · seed_stale and stop.
S3 resolve track: track words (联盟/affiliate, 推荐好友/referral, 合作伙伴/partner, agency, 国内站/国际站) select the track; none named → compare against every track of the row.

S4 extract claim facts with lexicon: rate, amount, duration, recurring vs one-time, ceiling words, cookie, recipient (referrer vs friend), reward form (cash vs credit), cap denial, region, join-now framing.

S5 compare each fact with the resolved track's facts. A contradiction that matches one of the row's misread_triggers (or a generic reason code) emits that reason code. A fact that only matches a different track emits track_conflated. A fact touching row.unresolved emits conflicting_official_wording.

S6 status checks when row.status ≠ open: closed + join-now or earning-now framing → program_closed; capped + cap denial → referral_cap; geo-limited + worldwide framing or an excluded region/account type → geo_excluded.
S7 lexicon checks on the whole paste: code_claim / private_rate → private_terms; income → income_claim; affiliation → claimed_affiliation; guarantee → guarantee_claimed.
S8 pick the label: highest precedence among emitted reason codes. 公开规则 only when at least one fact matched and nothing else fired. Nothing fired and nothing matched → 未核实 · no_checkable_fact.
classifier.per_row_not_global: Judge every keyword against the matched row. “Lifetime” recurring is the published rule for Kinsta, so it is 公开规则 there; the same wording is 易误解 for HubSpot, Kit, Framer and ElevenLabs.

rule_match.label: 公开规则
rule_match.zh: 与官方公开规则摘要一致。
rule_match.en: Consistent with the official public rule summary.

duration_overstated.label: 易误解
duration_overstated.zh: 官方条款写明是一次性或有期限，不是终身循环。
duration_overstated.en: Official terms are one-time or time-limited, not lifetime recurring.

ceiling_as_floor.label: 易误解
ceiling_as_floor.zh: 「最高 / 高达」是上限，不是每单固定值。
ceiling_as_floor.en: “Up to” is a ceiling, not a per-sale amount.

reward_misattributed.label: 易误解
reward_misattributed.zh: 这部分奖励属于被推荐人，或从推荐人自己的份额里切出。
reward_misattributed.en: That reward belongs to the referred person, or is carved out of the referrer's own share.

credit_as_cash.label: 易误解
credit_as_cash.zh: 奖励是平台内抵扣额或积分，不是现金。
credit_as_cash.en: The reward is platform credit, not cash.

track_conflated.label: 易误解
track_conflated.zh: 把两个不同计划（联盟 / 客户推荐 / 合作伙伴，或国内站 / 国际站）的条款拼在了一起。
track_conflated.en: Terms from two separate programs (affiliate / referral / partner, or mainland / international) are mixed together.

stale_terms.label: 易误解
stale_terms.zh: 引用的是旧版条款，现行规则已变更。
stale_terms.en: Cites superseded terms; the current rule differs.

conditions_omitted.label: 易误解
conditions_omitted.zh: 省略了官方列明的前提（付费资格、新客限定、扣税、分期、折扣门槛等）。
conditions_omitted.en: Leaves out conditions the official terms require (paid plan, new customers only, tax, staged payout, discount floors).

guarantee_claimed.label: 易误解
guarantee_claimed.zh: 官方条款不承诺任何收益。

unknown_program.label: 未核实
unknown_program.zh: 不在种子库内，无法对照公开规则。
unknown_program.en: Not in the seed set; there is no public rule to compare against.

seed_stale.label: 未核实
seed_stale.zh: 该项目条目尚未读原页复核或已过核对期，暂不下结论。
seed_stale.en: This entry has not been re-read on the official page or is past its check window; no verdict yet.

private_terms.label: 未核实
private_terms.zh: 私下费率、内部码或「特批」无法从公开条款核实。
private_terms.en: Private rates, “internal codes” or special tiers can't be verified from public terms.

income_claim.label: 未核实
income_claim.zh: 个人收入、截图或战绩无法核实。
income_claim.en: Personal income claims and screenshots can't be verified.

claimed_affiliation.label: 未核实
claimed_affiliation.zh: 自称与项目方有特殊关系，公开信息无法核实。
claimed_affiliation.en: A claimed special relationship with the vendor can't be verified from public information.

conflicting_official_wording.label: 未核实
conflicting_official_wording.zh: 官方页面自身表述不一致，暂不下结论。
conflicting_official_wording.en: Official pages word this differently; no verdict yet.

no_checkable_fact.label: 未核实
no_checkable_fact.zh: 说法里没有可对照的具体条款。
no_checkable_fact.en: The claim contains no checkable term.

program_closed.label: 关门反例
program_closed.zh: 该项目目前不接受新成员。
program_closed.en: This program is not accepting new members.

referral_cap.label: 关门反例
referral_cap.zh: 官方设有推荐人数或奖励上限。
referral_cap.en: Official terms cap referrals or rewards.

geo_excluded.label: 关门反例
geo_excluded.zh: 所说地区或账户类型不在官方可参与范围内。
geo_excluded.en: The stated region or account type is excluded by the official terms.

lexicon._note: Regex sources (JS, flags iu). Bracketed forms such as 稳[赚] match the plain word in a paste while keeping this file clean under the acceptance grep.

lexicon.recurring: 循环|每月|月月|续费|recurring|monthly|every month
lexicon.ceiling: 最高|高达|至多|up to|as much as
lexicon.per_unit: 每单|每个|一单|每人|每位|per (sale|signup|sign-up|referral|customer|order)
lexicon.friend: 好友|朋友|对方|被推荐人|被邀请人|friend|referee|invitee
lexicon.cap_denial: 无上限|不设上限|不限|无限|unlimited|no limit|uncapped
lexicon.worldwide: 全球|任何国家|哪都能|worldwide|global|anywhere|any country
lexicon.join_now: 申请|加入|招人|招募|上车|点我|join|apply|sign up now|now open|recruiting
lexicon.code_claim: 内部码|创始人码|专属码|私信|领取码|founder code|internal code|secret code|exclusive code|dm me
lexicon.private_rate: 内部价|内部渠道|特批|私下|私域价|vip ?(rate|tier)|negotiated|special tier|private rate
lexicon.income: 月入|日入|收入截图|战绩|躺[赚]|被动收入|i made|per month income|passive income|screenshot
lexicon.guarantee: 稳[赚]|保赚|包赚|必赚|年入百[万]|guaranteed|risk[- ]free|sure thing
lexicon.affiliation: 官方合[作]|官方授权|官方指定|official partner|authorized by|endorsed by

output_contract.render: Label chip (zh + en gloss) → one fixed zh/en line per reason code → official source link → 核对日期 / checked date. No numerals anywhere in the verdict except the date; the paste is never quoted or paraphrased.

share_line.offer_when: label = 公开规则 AND row.status = open; never on 易误解 / 未核实 / 关门反例

template.zh: {program_zh} 有公开的推荐计划，条款以官方页为准：{official_url}（核对 {as_of}）· 我的链接：{own_link} ｜ 推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate
template.en: {program_en} runs a public referral program; the official page governs: {official_url} (checked {as_of}) · my link: {own_link} | 推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate

share_line.slots: {own_link} is typed by the user and starts empty; the instrument never pre-fills, suggests, shortens or rewrites it, and never inserts a code

board.row_cta: status = open → one plain official URL (row.join_cta, no query params) labelled 官方页 / Official page; any other status → no CTA, source link only
board.evidence_marker: evidence = search_index_extract or page_read = false → muted marker 待读原页 / Awaiting page read

classifier.seed_policy: track facts are comparator input only and are never rendered. Every row starts as evidence = search_index_extract, page_read = false: official domains were unreachable from the drafting environment, so every fact comes from search-engine extracts of official pages.

acceptance: A1 Hype grep: `grep -rnE '稳[赚]|年入百[万]|官方合[作]' .` over the repo, this spec, copy and the built output returns nothing (exit 1). The bracket form keeps this spec clean under its own grep.

A2 Closed rows: `document.querySelectorAll('[data-status]:not([data-status="open"]) [data-cta="join"]').length === 0`, and every seed row whose status is not open has join_cta = null (notion, ibkr-friend-referral, binance-fee-share).

A3 No take-rate: for the 5 fixtures and a 200-paste fuzz corpus, the text of [data-region="verdict"] minus [data-field="as_of"] contains no [0-9０-９] and no match for /你能[拿赚]|you('ll| will| can| could) (earn|make|get|receive)/i.
A4 No codes: no shipped file or rendered DOM matches /[?&](ref|via|code|invite|aff|referral)=/i; the share line's {own_link} renders empty until the user types.
A5 Share line: every rendered share line contains the exact substring “推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate”; share lines appear only when label = 公开规则 and row status = open (fixture F1 yes; F2–F5 no).
A6 Fixtures: with the matched row verified, all 5 fixtures return their expect.label and expect.reason_codes; with it unverified, each returns 未核实 · seed_stale.

A7 Seed integrity: 15 rows; each has at least one official source URL, as_of, evidence, confidence. Launch is blocked until every row has page_read = true; CI downgrades any row whose verified_on is older than 90 days.
A8 Determinism and privacy: the same paste run 100 times gives identical output; after page load, pasting fires zero network requests.
A9 Bilingual: every UI string key has non-empty zh and en; label chips always show the zh label plus the en gloss.
A10 Look: all text including label chips is WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1) on its surface; no horizontal scroll at 360px; no animation beyond the 150ms fade.
A11 Identity: not served from gravity.li; no GRAVITY or vendor logos; the standing disclosure appears on every view.

empty.zh: 粘贴一条推荐或返佣说法，一次一条。只返回一个标签：公开规则、易误解、未核实或关门反例，附官方来源和核对日期。不算收益，不给推荐码。
empty.en: Paste one referral or commission claim. Returns a single label (Public rule, Commonly misread, Unverified, or Closed / capped / geo) with the official source and the date it was checked. No earnings math, no codes.

standing_disclosure.zh: 独立站点，非 gravity.li，与所列任何公司均无隶属、授权或背书关系。标签依据各项目官方公开页面，逐条注明核对日期；条款可能随时变更，以官方页面为准。本站不计算、不承诺任何个人收益，也不生成或提供推荐码。本站建议的分享文案一律标注「推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate」。不构成投资、法律或税务建议。
standing_disclosure.en: Independent site, not gravity.li, and not affiliated with, authorized or endorsed by any company listed. Labels rest on each program's official public pages, each with the date it was checked; terms can change at any time and the official page prevails. We don't calculate or promise anyone's earnings, and we never generate or hand out referral codes. Every share line we suggest carries “推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate”. Not investment, legal or tax advice.

dont_repeat.zh: 把有期限的分成说成终身：HubSpot、Kit、Framer、ElevenLabs 的比例分成都有 12 个月上限；Kinsta 的“终身”只指该客户套餐仍在付费的期间。
dont_repeat.en: Calling time-limited commission lifetime: HubSpot, Kit, Framer and ElevenLabs cap it at 12 months; Kinsta's “lifetime” lasts only while the customer's plan is paid.

dont_repeat.zh: 把「最高 / up to」当成每单固定值或保证收入（Shopify、Kinsta、Coursera、阿里云、腾讯云）。
dont_repeat.en: Treating “up to” as a per-sale amount or a guarantee (Shopify, Kinsta, Coursera, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud).

dont_repeat.zh: 把被推荐人的奖励算到推荐人头上：IBKR 的股票归好友；Binance 返给好友的部分从推荐人份额里切出。
dont_repeat.en: Crediting the friend's reward to the referrer: IBKR shares go to the friend; Binance kickbacks come out of the referrer's own share.

dont_repeat.zh: 把抵扣额或积分说成现金：Airalo Airmoney、Deel 预付账单抵扣额、阿里云/腾讯云国际站邀请积分。
dont_repeat.en: Calling credits cash: Airalo Airmoney, Deel Prepaid Billing Credits, Alibaba/Tencent international invite credits.

dont_repeat.zh: 把联盟、客户推荐、合作伙伴/代理计划，或国内站与国际站的条款拼在一起（Deel、HubSpot、Shopify、Framer、阿里云、腾讯云）。
dont_repeat.en: Mixing affiliate, customer-referral and partner/agency terms, or mainland and international sites (Deel, HubSpot, Shopify, Framer, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud).

dont_repeat.zh: 沿用旧条款：ConvertKit 旧版终身比例、HubSpot 旧 cookie、Binance BNB 持仓档位、Deel 旧礼品卡、阿里云旧版最高比例。
dont_repeat.en: Reusing superseded terms: old ConvertKit lifetime rate, HubSpot's old cookie, Binance BNB-holding tiers, Deel's old gift card, Alibaba Cloud's old top rate.

dont_repeat.zh: 省略官方前提：注册不等于计佣、只限新客或首购、试用单为零、扣税与分期发放、折扣门槛、资格身份。
dont_repeat.en: Dropping official conditions: a sign-up isn't a sale, new or first purchase only, trials pay zero, tax and staged payouts, discount floors, eligible account types.

dont_repeat.zh: 给关门、限额或限地区的项目放加入入口或推荐链接（Notion 已停招；IBKR 有人数上限与地区排除；Binance 多地不可参与）。
dont_repeat.en: Putting a join entry or referral link on closed, capped or geo-limited programs (Notion closed; IBKR capped and region-excluded; Binance unavailable in many regions).

open_questions: 开放行的「官方页」按钮保持官方原始链接（默认，本站零佣金），还是换成本站自己的推荐链接？若换，每行都要加注「推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate」，并逐项确认条款允许这种投放（例如 Framer、ElevenLabs 禁止品牌词竞价和付费投放）。
